HFCL had posted net profit of around Rs 72 crore in the same period a year ago.
"This is the best-ever quarterly performance in HFCL's history and marks a defining moment in our growth journey. The results reflect the increasing scale, strength and momentum of our business and reinforce our confidence in HFCL's ability to deliver sustained growth and create enduring value for stakeholders," HFCL managing director, Mahendra Nahata, said in a statement.
